name: Jean-Luc Dubois
bio:
Jean-Luc's journey into motorsport began unconventionally, not on the track, but in his grandfather's autobody shop nestled in the Swiss Alps. Surrounded by the scent of lacquer and the gleaming curves of classic cars, he developed an innate understanding of paint technology and surface preparation. He honed his skills through years of meticulous restoration work, eventually specializing in custom finishes and complex paint schemes. 

His passion for racing led him to Hansen World RX Team, where he quickly established himself as a reliable and innovative paint specialist. Jean-Luc is known for his ability to blend artistry with technical precision, ensuring that every vehicle not only looks stunning but also benefits from enhanced aerodynamic efficiency thanks to his meticulous surface preparation. He sees his role as more than just applying paint; he's crafting a visual identity that reflects the team's spirit and performance on the track. His detail-oriented approach and commitment to quality make him an invaluable asset to the team.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly trimmed, with a slight receding hairline
physical.description: Jean-Luc has a focused gaze and the strong, calloused hands of someone who works diligently with his craft.

quirks: Always wears a vintage Heuer Monaco chronograph while working.
Insists on using traditional Swiss cowbells to signal the start of a new paint job.
Has a habit of meticulously cleaning his workspace, even when it's already spotless.
